oson-uy.title: Oson Uy
oson-uy.summary: A property rental and sales platform for Tashkent with map search, rich filters, and a secure agent back-office.
oson-uy.overview: Oson Uy is a real-estate marketplace connecting buyers, renters, and agents across Tashkent. SDS designed and built the platform end to end — from the listing experience to the agent dashboard.
oson-uy.problem: The local market relied on scattered listings across chat groups and classifieds. Buyers struggled to filter by what mattered, and agents had no reliable way to manage inquiries or keep listings up to date.
oson-uy.solution: We built a fast Next.js platform with map-based search, granular filters, verified listings, and a secure agent dashboard. Server-rendered pages keep listings SEO-friendly, while a clean data model keeps inventory consistent.

crm-dashboard.title: Operations CRM
crm-dashboard.summary: An operations CRM with live analytics, alerts, and automated reporting for a logistics team.
crm-dashboard.overview: A custom CRM and operations dashboard for a logistics company that had outgrown spreadsheets. SDS replaced manual tracking with a single real-time system.
crm-dashboard.problem: Operations were spread across spreadsheets and messaging apps. Status was always out of date, reporting took days, and nobody had a single source of truth.
crm-dashboard.solution: We built a role-based CRM on Next.js and NestJS with live shipment tracking over WebSockets, automated reporting, and configurable alerts. Redis-backed caching keeps dashboards instant even with heavy data.

mobile-app.title: KidsCity Mobile App
mobile-app.summary: A cross-platform mobile app for booking visits, tickets, and events at a family entertainment venue.
mobile-app.overview: A React Native app for a family entertainment brand, letting parents browse activities, book visits, and manage tickets from their phone.
mobile-app.problem: Bookings happened by phone and at the door, creating queues and no-shows. The brand had no direct channel to reach returning families.
mobile-app.solution: We shipped a polished cross-platform app with browsing, scheduling, secure payments, and push notifications — backed by Firebase for auth, data, and messaging.
